metadata.description: Comprehensive glossary of karmic astrology terms, symbols, and abbreviations.

symbols.name: North Node
symbols.karmic_meaning: The soul's evolutionary direction; unfamiliar territory representing the growth needed in this lifetime.

symbols.name: South Node
symbols.karmic_meaning: Accumulated past-life experiences and habits; the 'comfort zone' that can become a trap if over-relied upon.

symbols.name: Saturn
symbols.karmic_meaning: The Lord of Karma; represents structural lessons, boundaries, and the areas of life where discipline leads to mastery.

symbols.name: Pluto
symbols.karmic_meaning: In Evolutionary Astrology, represents the Soul itself and its deepest unconscious desires for transformation.

symbols.name: Retrograde
symbols.karmic_meaning: Internalized planetary energy; indicates past-life themes requiring deep internal revision or resolution.

terms.definition: The path of right action and spiritual purpose; often associated with the North Node's direction.
Unresolved energy or actions from previous incarnations that manifest as specific challenges or 'blocks' in the current life.
A planet squaring the Nodal Axis (forming a 90° angle to both North and South Nodes). It represents a lesson that was bypassed in a past life and must be addressed now.
The specific Lunar Node that a planet in a 'Skipped Step' configuration must move toward to resolve the karmic tension.
The 4th, 8th, and 12th houses, which deal with the unconscious, ancestry, and hidden soul memories.
When the transiting North Node returns to its natal position (approx. every 18.6 years), signaling a major karmic checkpoint.
When transiting Saturn returns to its natal position (approx. every 29.5 years), marking a period of intense karmic accountability and maturation.
The underlying evolutionary purpose behind a specific chart configuration.

frameworks.name: Evolutionary Astrology (EA)
frameworks.core_principle: The Soul (Pluto) chooses its evolutionary path via the Nodal Axis.

frameworks.name: Karmic Axis Framework
frameworks.core_principle: The Lunar Nodes are the central axis of the chart, describing the soul's trajectory.

calculations.name: Aspect Strength
calculations.description: Calculates the relative impact of an aspect based on the planets involved and the precision of the angle.

calculations.name: Nodal Resolution Direction
calculations.logic: If planet squares nodes, identify which node it last made a conjunction with (South or North) to determine the resolution path.
calculations.description: Determines whether the soul needs to integrate the South Node's past or the North Node's future to resolve a skipped step.

calculations.name: Karmic Load Index
calculations.formula: Load = Σ(Karmic Multipliers * Planet Weight) for all planets in 4th, 8th, 12th houses or retrograde.
calculations.description: A composite score representing the overall 'karmic weight' or density of the chart.
